notes:
Model solutions as files, one per level

The level editor will save solutions, and a hundred new levels need a
solution each: they become data (presets/solutions/<level id>.json, one
part and wire per line for short diffs) instead of code in the tests.
The Python builders move to tools/make/solutions/; the new command
'solutions' writes the missing files from them, only if they pass with
three stars, and leaves existing files alone unless --force names them,
since they may come from the editor. Tests and tools read the files, which
also halves the test run.
